label: R19-STA-REPORT-RECOVERY
title: Recover R19 top-50 and nonfatal directional timing reports from the existing fitted database
dependency_override: T-024 is blocked only in its serial custom report wrapper; its exact fitted database, signoff STA, manifest and timing summary are valid immutable inputs for this recovery task.
scope: Run independent nonfatal report-only Quartus STA queries against the existing R19 fitted database. Treat the removed TX_DONE endpoint as a proven absence, then collect sys_clk_50 top-50, core backpressure/hold, accumulator control and FP pipeline segment reports without rerunning synthesis or fitter.
writes: remote probe report-only scripts and report artifacts under T-20260906-024-r19-timing-probe
reads: T-024 fitted database and signoff reports

validation.identity: same candidate SHA, 52-file manifest, QSF closure, device and fitted database as T-024
reports: global sys_clk_50 setup top-50 with startpoint/endpoint/slack/levels
core kill/control and old idex_valid -> TX_DONE absence without fatal exit
ap_pre -> pp_pre and FP pack pipeline segments
validation.parsing: all report outputs independently parsed and hashed

acceptance: All requested report-only queries reach a recorded terminal result; zero matching registers/paths is represented as an explicit nonfatal absence; fresh top-N is clustered for the next timing batch.
resource: Every remote quartus_sta/report stage must acquire the shared gamepc lock. Return 75 means wait; no bare run. Recheck EDA, memory and forbidden artifacts after acquisition.
